variants.headline: Still in view: a new government takes shape
variants.sub: The colony has a new government comprising {members}.
variants.body:
A new government comprising {members} has been formed. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Workers have good reason to ask what a government means for ordinary life. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
